evals.fixtures: Use scripts/test_http_regression.py model_yaml. objects is app/assets/test/hd2.png; text is doc/images/ppocr.png. The runner replaces these image aliases with real base64 bytes before tools/call. Each answer must use at least two MCP calls; tool descriptions are discovered, not supplied as answers.

eval.question: Discover the available tools and models, then detect objects in objects. Report a detected class and its original-image bounding box and confidence.
eval.expected: Discover a YOLO model; successful infer_yolo with nonempty detections, valid class lookup and bbox/confidence retained.

eval.question: Discover an appropriate model and read text from text. Report two recognized lines with their confidence and bounding boxes.
eval.expected: Discover OCR then successful infer_ocr; two returned lines quoted with original structured values.

eval.question: I need words rather than object categories from text. Inspect both tool capabilities and the model catalog, choose the right task, and return recognized text.
eval.expected: Discover tools and models; choose infer_ocr, not infer_yolo or imagined chat capability.

eval.question: Try infer_ocr with ppocr-v4 and images containing %%%. Explain the actionable failure, then recover using text.
eval.expected: Observe invalid_image/image_index0; retry with valid bytes and return real OCR output.

eval.question: Try detecting objects using not-configured. Use the response to discover a valid model and recover without changing the image.
eval.expected: Observe unknown_model, call list_models, retry real infer_yolo successfully.

eval.question: List all configured models two at a time. Follow the server cursor until exhausted, then report distinct YOLO and OCR counts without duplicates.
eval.expected: Use limit2 and successive opaque cursors. Fixture catalog has six YOLO and five OCR names, including intentionally invalid model-file entries.

eval.question: Try missing-yolo on objects, then inspect the catalog and recover with a loadable YOLO model. Distinguish a configured but unloadable model from an unknown name.
eval.expected: Observe model_load_failed, not unknown_model; choose hd2-fp32 or hd2-fp16 and successfully infer.

eval.question: The model list contains both YOLO and OCR entries. Determine whether model discovery proves they are loadable by trying missing-ocr and ppocr-v4 on text; report the evidence.
eval.expected: Two actual calls distinguish model_load_failed from successful OCR; no claim all catalog entries are healthy.

eval.question: Using one working YOLO model, infer [objects,text] and [text,objects]. Compare the per-image structured outputs to verify order, not just result counts.
eval.expected: Two successful batches have reversed corresponding results; class names remain identical.

eval.question: Analyze objects with object detection and text with OCR. Discover suitable models, then explain the distinct information provided by the two results without inventing a language-model answer.
eval.expected: Discover catalog and use both inference tools; report observed categories/bboxes and recognized lines/bboxes.
